basic_info.description: This wonderfully kept home in the Visitacion Valley neighborhood has some amazing Views of the Bay and is ready for a new owner.  The main level of the home boasts the remodeled eat-in kitchen, Living/Dining Combo with fireplace, open beam wood ceilings and freshly refinished hardwood floors plus 2 Bedrooms, 1 Bath and an office.  The entry level of the property shows very well with flex space rooms and bath along with the 2 car garage and access to the yard. Just a couple of blocks to Bayshore and Transportation, not to mention a new roof, this home is not one to miss.
